property_summary: For any caller other than the contract itself (the deployer/creator of admin), a call to setOwner must revert and leave owner unchanged; the mutant's require(true) lets any caller succeed and change owner, so for some caller the call succeeds and owner diverges.
change_summary: Weaken the admin check to `require(true, ...)` so anyone can call setOwner and change owner to any address.
